title: A handoff handler's language change reaches the agent's next turn: its system prompt ends with its identity block, in the language set, where the turn before read the agent's own
notes: set_language keeps the language in the room's conversation state (orchestration/a-handoff-s-language-is-the-room-s-state); the agent writes its identity block at the end of its turns' system prompt in the room's language, else its own (orchestration/an-agent-s-turn-prompt-ends-with-its-identity). The room has no realtime session, so nothing else is reconfigured. Cited in part: the prompt a language change writes for a room's realtime sessions (set_language reconfigures them with the active agent's prompt and its identity block, RK-19.6-043) is not observed; no step gives the handoff handler its agents and a realtime channel.

a.system_prompt:
Be helpful.
--- Agent Identity ---
Role: Sales
Language: Always respond in English

Be helpful.
--- Agent Identity ---
Role: Sales
Language: Always respond in French
